content.short: StonkBrokers is a 4,444-piece NFT collection on Robinhood Chain with ERC-6551 token-bound wallets.
content.description: StonkBrokers is a collection of 4,444 pixel-art brokers on Robinhood Chain, each holding an ERC-6551 token-bound account so the NFT itself owns a wallet and can hold assets or trade. Token-bound accounts turn an NFT from a static item into something that carries state, which is a more interesting use of the standard than most collections attempt.
content.meta: 4,444 pixel brokers whose ERC-6551 accounts let the NFT itself hold assets.
